how: Fresh held-out Ruby set (2026-11-15): sinatra, devise, fastlane, puma, hanami (last 1,000 commits each, tests/specs/vendor left out). Engine-independent loose candidates (harness/heldout/loose.ts with NO_ENGINE=1), a fixed-seed sample of up to 70 same-file candidates per project (todo.ts, NO_ENGINE=1), labelled blind by independent Fable agents from a counts-only copy of harness/LABELLING.md. Fixed before the engine was run on any of these files.
